life_tap.compare: Compare holding life with drawing. Both margins assume the example trades work and remaining minions/weapon connect unblocked. Taunts can prevent that damage. Check hero power, visible effects, damage prevention, Shreds, waking minions and plausible reach. At a thin margin prefer a useful play/trade already available. For a risky Tap name a specific affordable immediate out; if holding already loses, drawing for a live out can be best.
